top.impact_reason: Zoning changes increase development potential in Al Satwa.
top.headline: Dubai permits eight-floor buildings in Al Satwa
top.summary: Dubai Municipality has updated planning rules to allow residential developments up to eight floors in Al Satwa. The policy shift aims to encourage investment and stimulate neighborhood growth.

top.title: Dubai changes Al Satwa property rules to allow 8-storey residential developments
top.impact_reason: Permits taller residential buildings in Al Satwa.
